Bill.BriefDescription: Appointing an expert review panel for the Alaskan Way viaduct deep bore tunnel project by the transportation commission.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the appointment of an expert review panel forthe Alaskan Way viaduct deep bore tunnel project by the transportationcommission; and adding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes that the finance and projectimplementation planning processes required for the state route 99 andAlaskan Way viaduct deep bore tunnel project cannot guaranteeappropriate decisions unless key study assumptions are reasonable withrespect to the project. For the purposes of this section, the AlaskanWay viaduct deep bore tunnel project, or tunnel project, means allcomponents of the project including, but not limited to, utilitiesrelocation, central seawall repair and replacement, transitenhancements, and surface street improvements. To assure appropriatefinance plan and project implementation plan assumptions, an expertreview panel shall be appointed to provide independent financial andtechnical review for development of a finance plan and projectimplementation plan for the project described in this section. p. 1 HB 2217 (1) The expert review panel shall consist of five to ten memberswho are recognized experts in relevant fields, such as planning,engineering, finance, law, the environment, emerging transportationtechnologies, geography, geology, and economics. (2) The expert review panel shall be selected by the transportationcommission. (3) The chair of the expert review panel shall be designated by thechair of the transportation commission. (4) The expert review panel shall, with respect to completion ofthe tunnel project: (a) Review the financing plan for the project to ensure that itclearly identifies secured and anticipated funding sources and isfeasible and sufficient; (b) Review the project implementation plan covering all state andlocal permitting and mitigation approvals that ensure the mostexpeditious and costeffective delivery of the project; and (c) Report its findings and recommendations on the items describedin (a) and (b) of this subsection to the joint transportationcommittee, the transportation commission, the office of financialmanagement, and the governor by September 1, 2009. (5) Upon receipt of the expert review panel's findings andrecommendations under subsection (4)(c) of this section, the governormust make a finding of whether the finance plan is feasible andsufficient to complete the project. (6) Nothing in this section shall be interpreted to delayconstruction of any of the projects referenced in this section.
